name: Chad
prevalence_note: Airtel Tchad and Airtel Money Tchad have warned about a fraudulent Facebook page offering supposed Starlink mobile packages paid with Airtel Money, used to harvest the wallet PIN. The BEAC has also warned CEMAC residents about a fake financing notice circulated in its name.
cross_border_note: Calls and messages are usually in French or Arabic and may use Chadian mobiles. BEAC-themed lures circulate across the CEMAC area; operator-wallet PIN requests may also arrive in chat apps rather than only by voice call.

scams.name: Fausse offre Starlink pour obtenir le code PIN Airtel Money
scams.name_en: Fake Starlink offer used to harvest an Airtel Money PIN

red_flag_keywords.text: offers a satellite-to-phone package paid through Airtel Money and then solicits the wallet PIN
moves the customer from a social-media page into a chat or website to collect the PIN
presents an unofficial page as a partner of the mobile-money service

scams.signals_en: A Facebook page or follow-up chat offers Starlink-for-phone packages payable with Airtel Money and then asks the customer in Chad for the wallet PIN, often on WhatsApp or on a website the operator has not published as its own.
scams.legit_en: Airtel Tchad and Airtel Money Tchad said they have no link with that page, that the PIN must stay confidential and must not be given to a third party, and that the Starlink-for-phone service was not available in Chad when the warning was issued.
bait_tactics: Je ne communique pas mon code PIN Airtel Money pour un forfait présenté sur une page que je n'ai pas ouverte depuis un canal que je connais déjà.
Cette page n'est pas un partenaire que j'ai moi-même vérifié chez mon opérateur, je n'entre dans aucun site qu'elle m'envoie.
Je ne dicte ni ne saisis mon code confidentiel dans une conversation ou un formulaire lancé par une offre de connexion.

scams.name: Faux avis de financement de projets au nom de la BEAC
scams.name_en: Fake BEAC project-finance notice asking for a payment

red_flag_keywords.text: circulates a tender or finance notice in the name of the regional central bank and asks for a personal contribution
claims the central bank is funding private or sub-regional projects in exchange for a fee
directs the customer to treat a social-media document as an official call for funds

scams.signals_en: A message or document presented as a BEAC call for offers invites a person in Chad to take part in a large project-finance operation and to pay a personal contribution, even though the Bank has said it does not finance such projects against a fee.
scams.legit_en: The BEAC has disowned a fraudulent call-for-offers on social media. It does not finance national or sub-regional projects in return for a fee, and money-market operations are reserved for CEMAC credit institutions. Official information is on its own site.
bait_tactics: Je ne verse aucune contrepartie pour un prétendu financement de projet annoncé au nom de la BEAC.
Ce document d'appel d'offres n'est pas un texte que j'ai ouvert sur le site que j'utilise déjà pour cette banque, je n'y réponds pas.
Je ne donne aucun RIB ni aucun dépôt à un interlocuteur qui dit lancer une opération de la banque centrale sur les réseaux sociaux.
